key.name: capture-area-shortcut
key.summary: Keybinding to trigger a PureShot area capture
key.description: Compositor-level keybinding (works on Wayland) that asks the PureShot companion to take an area-selection screenshot. Change it with gsettings or a keyboard shortcut editor that supports custom GSettings-backed bindings.

key.name: capture-ocr-shortcut
key.summary: Keybinding to capture an area and copy recognized text
key.description: Unassigned by default. An empty array disables this binding.
